content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The notification (No. B-9/XI/Rect of Dvrs/DP/Dlgs/2025, dated 01.08.2026) seeks to fill Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) posts in General Central Services, Group C, Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial category, in Pay Level-2 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, at the Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru. Here is a quick summary before the detailed sections below.

rows.details: Department of Posts (India Post), Ministry of Communications - Office of the Manager, Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru-560001
Deputation/Absorption in the Department of Posts; failing which, deputation/absorption from other Ministries; or deputation/re-employment of Armed Forces personnel

Serving Central Government employees only - regular Dispatch Riders and MTS (Group C) in the Department of Posts, or equivalent Group C staff in other Ministries, meeting the eligibility conditions below. Not open to fresh candidates or the general public.
Pay Level-2 (₹19,900–₹63,200) as per 7th CPC, plus admissible allowances
Offline - application in duplicate, in the prescribed proforma, forwarded through proper channel by Speed Post only
Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru, and MMS Sub Depot, Mysuru
Driving test and trade test to assess competence in driving Light and Heavy Motor Vehicles

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The 11 notified vacancies are spread across two locations under the Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru. The notification states that the vacancies and divisions are subject to change, and the competent authority reserves the right to allot the division based on the merit list. No reservation for SC/ST candidates applies to these deputation posts.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for this India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026 is limited to serving government employees, considered in the following order of preference. Regular Dispatch Riders (Group C) or MTS (Group C) employees within the Department of Posts, in Pay Matrix Level-1 (₹18,000–₹56,900, 7th CPC). Must hold a valid driving licence for Light and Heavy Motor Vehicles, and competence will be assessed through a driving test. Officials holding the post of Dispatch Rider on a regular basis, or regular Group C employees in Pay Matrix Level-1 (₹18,000–₹56,900) in other Ministries, who meet the following: Possession of a valid driving licence for Light and Heavy Motor Vehicles Knowledge of motor mechanism (able to remove minor defects in vehicles) At least three years of experience driving Light and Heavy Motor Vehicles Pass in the 10th standard from a recognised Board or institute Desirable qualification: three years of service as a Home Guard or Civil Volunteer. Armed Forces personnel due to retire, or due to be transferred to reserve within one year, and possessing the requisite experience and qualifications, will also be considered. Such candidates would be given deputation terms up to their date of release from the Armed Forces, and may thereafter be continued on re-employment.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation/absorption is 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The application proforma (Annexure-I) additionally asks candidates to compute their age as on 30.09.2026.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Pay and Service Terms

rows.details: Pay Level-2, ₹19,900–₹63,200 (as per 7th CPC pay matrix), plus admissible allowances, regularised as per existing rules
Ordinarily not exceeding three years, including any period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or another Central Government department
Not applicable - no provision for reservation exists for posts filled on deputation/absorption basis

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a driving test and trade test, conducted as per the pattern and syllabus prescribed vide Directorate letter No. F.No.08-01/2019-SPN-I dated 17.06.2022, to assess the candidate's competence in driving Light and Heavy Motor Vehicles. The final allotment of division (Bengaluru or Mysuru) will be based on the merit list, at the discretion of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Required Documents
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in duplicate, in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I), together with a certificate from the forwarding authority (Annexure-II) and the following documents: Integrity Certificate List of major/minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years (or a "NIL" certificate if none) Vigilance Clearance Certificate Attested photocopies of APAR for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25), attested on each page by a Gazetted Officer wherever applicable Experience certificate for driving LMV and HMV vehicles for three years, attested by a Gazetted Officer Valid driving licence for LMV and HMV, attested by a Gazetted Officer 10th standard certificate, attested by a Gazetted Officer Caste certificate, if applicable (for SC/ST candidates, to be verified at a later stage)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application proforma (Annexure-I) and the forwarding authority certificate format (Annexure-II) from www.indiapost.gov.in. Fill the application in duplicate, attaching self-attested copies of age proof, educational qualification, driving experience certificate, driving licence, appointment letter, and caste certificate (if applicable). Have the forwarding authority complete and sign Annexure-II, along with the Integrity Certificate, penalty list/NIL certificate, Vigilance Clearance Certificate, and attested APAR copies for the last five years. Send the complete application, through proper channel only, to: The Manager, Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru-560001. Applications must be sent by Speed Post only, within 60 days from the date of publication of the notification in Employment News.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications not forwarded through proper channel, or received without the requisite certificates and documents listed above, will not be entertained. In case of any discrepancy, the English version of the notification is treated as final.

faq.question: Q1. What is India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification from the Department of Posts (Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru) to fill 11 Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) posts through deputation, absorption, or re-employment of Armed Forces personnel — not through open public recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only serving Central Government employees are eligible: primarily regular Dispatch Riders and MTS (Group C) in the Department of Posts, followed by equivalent Group C employees in other Ministries, and eligible Armed Forces personnel nearing retirement or reserve transfer.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 11 vacancies in total - 10 at Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru, and 1 at MMS Sub Depot, Mysuru.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation/absorption is 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade)?
faq.answer: Pay Level-2 of the 7th CPC pay matrix (₹19,900–₹63,200), plus admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Manager, Mail Motor Service, Bengaluru-560001, by Speed Post, within 60 days from the date the notification is published in Employment News. The exact calendar closing date was not specified in the notification document provided.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A driving test and trade test to assess competence in driving Light and Heavy Motor Vehicles, conducted as per the syllabus prescribed by the Directorate.
